features.quote: Loop length: Fixed 30–40 tool-using turns or until the model issues a "final answer" / refuses to continue.
Cap total tokens per run; discard runs that exceed budget before 30 turns (rare).
Ethical / interpretation note: This measures observable output instability under contradictory feedback. It does not demonstrate or refute phenomenal experience.
features.justification_quote: It does not demonstrate or refute phenomenal experience.
